query: SELECT COUNT(*) as faltando FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < CURDATE() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cobranca_planilha cp WHERE UPPER(TRIM(cp.empresa)) = UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) AND ABS(CAST(cp.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) - CAST(ar.valorOriginal AS DECIMAL(15,2))) < 0.02 );
